description: Equipo interesado en el desarrollo de tecnologías sustentables
summary: A short film, developed with the support of artificial intelligence, was created to present the contributions of Phoenix and InSight in a clear, dynamic, and visual manner. Using AI tools, the project produced audiovisual resources that transformed technical data into accessible content, engagingly explaining the objectives, functions, achievements, and benefits of both initiatives. The significance of this project lies in its ability to communicate the real-world impact of Phoenix and InSight through an innovative approach, thereby enhancing the visibility of their outcomes. This dynamic format facilitates decision-making, fosters a better understanding of their contributions, and highlights the value generated by both platforms.
details:
operation

The short film serves as a way to convey past events in a visually entertaining manner, showcasing what the Phoenix and InSight missions accomplished on Mars.

Benefits

Its purpose is to explain, in a visual and entertaining way, what the Phoenix and InSight missions accomplished on Mars. The short film is primarily aimed at children aged 6 to 10; therefore, it incorporates images, animations, and simple explanations that make certain aspects of space exploration easy to understand, without relying on an excessive number of scientific terms.

Expected impact

To enable children to learn about and understand—in a dynamic and visually engaging way—the functions carried out by the Phoenix and InSight missions, and to better grasp the importance of exploring Mars.

Tools

  • Google Flow
  • Google Gemini
  • CapCut
  • canva

Creativo

The project depicts a space mission aimed at learning more about the planet Mars. It was specifically designed to capture the interest of children. Rather than relying solely on written reports, the creators developed a visual experience that allows viewers to visualize and imagine the missions carried out by the Phoenix and InSight landers. The use of artificial intelligence made it possible to adapt and visualize elements that enhanced the appeal of the short film.

I work collaboratively

During development, the team took into account the target age group for the short film, the ease of understanding the missions, the duration of the short film, and the information presented.
